name: BLWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's top belt, first won by Celeste LaRue at GoldRush on 16 June 2007 and passed through nine reigns in ten months, among them a tournament crowning Hallow Wicked on 12 November 2007; the champions page ends 'Championship Vacant due to BLW Closer'.
notes: Also called 'the Universal Championship' in the eXposed of November 2007 and a World title on the champions page.

name: BLWA BLLV Championship
epitaph: A second singles belt whose own list opens on 3 February 2008 with Steve Smith beating Drake Daniels and ends with Dari Wheeler's Rumble win on 30 April 2008; the page does not say what the letters stand for.

name: BLWA Prime Time Championship
epitaph: The champions page lists a Grand Prix belt crowned at GoldRush on 16 June 2007 under the Prime Time heading; the entries from 16 December 2007 name the Prime Time title without a prefix, and the last holder was Dave Johnson on 6 April 2008.
notes: The Grand Prix and the Prime Time entries share one list on the champions page and are filed as one belt.

name: BLWA TVX Championship
epitaph: Desperado was 'first and only TVX Champion' at GoldRush on 16 June 2007, a belt listed under the Prime Time heading.

name: BLWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Team Vendetta were the first Tag Team champions at GoldRush on 16 June 2007; the Ring Generals, Stoner and Dark Wolf, DOA and Shawn Hunt with Jaden Lee or Brian Cady held the belts until DOA's reign when the fed closed.
